entries.title: The Planet Crafter
entries.definitive_edition: The Planet Crafter on Windows PC with Planet Humble

emulation.notes: Use the native PC build; no emulation is needed.

primary.version: Current 2.0 PC release with Planet Humble available
primary.why: The Windows PC version is the released platform available now and the only complete route for current content, including the Planet Humble DLC and the 2.0 update. PS5 and Xbox Series X/S are announced for July 21, 2026, but they are future access routes as of June 23, 2026.
primary.how_to_play: Play the current Windows PC version on Steam or GOG, add Planet Humble for the paid extra planet, and use the current 2.0+ build.

entries.remaster_caveats: The 2.0 update is an update to the existing PC game, not a remaster. Planet Humble is DLC rather than a separate game entry. PS5 and Xbox Series X/S are future ports until July 21, 2026.
